test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the highlighted word.

The __hapless__ incident was a result of sheer negligence by the authorities.
solution: The correct answer is** “ill-fated”**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Hapless**" means unfortunate or having bad luck. (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण या बुरी किस्मत वाला) • **Example**- The hapless victims of the disaster were in dire need of help. • **"Ill-fated"** means marked by or inviting misfortune. (दुर्भाग्य द्वारा चिह्नित या दुर्भाग्य को आमंत्रित करना) • **Example**- The ill-fated voyage ended in tragedy when the ship sank. • Hence, the option that is Similar in meaning to the given word is 'ill-fated’. Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3’**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options. • **Joyful**: feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness. (महान आनंद और खुशी का अनुभव, व्यक्त, या कारण बनना) • **Triumphant**: having won a battle or contest; victorious. (एक युद्ध या प्रतियोगिता जीतने; विजयी) • **Grateful**: feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness. (सराहना का अनुभव या प्रदर्शन करना) 119:T5f6, The correct answer is “**down to earth”.**
